summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, attaching a press release providing an operations update for the Goose Mine and announcing exploration drill results from the Back River Gold District in Nunavut, Canada. The release reports commissioning of a new mobile crushing plant in August 2026 exceeding 3,000 tpd, fixed-plant throughput expected to reach 3,200 tpd from October 2026, and 2026 production guidance of 170,000–200,000 ounces. Highlight intercepts include 19.12 g/t gold over 21.23 m at Llama and 44.61 g/t over 4.65 m. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; this is a routine operational and exploration update, not a special situation.
